name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 3; Council Decision 89/367/EEC – Article 2 – paragraph 2 – point a – 20
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Council Decision 89/367/EEC setting up a Standing Forestry Committee
part_text: (a) to assist, closely cooperate with, and provide expertise and input to the Commission in the preparation of legislative proposals, strategies, communications, guidelines or other Union policy initiatives relevant to forests and forestry, including in the implementation of the New EU Forest Strategy for 2030 and subsequent Union Forest Strategies.
